newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Sanda in talks to buy Maju Steel.
newsitem.headline: Sanda in talks to buy Maju Steel.

text.p: Malaysia's Sanda Plastics Industries Bhd said on Wednesday it is negotiating with Maju Holdings Sdn Bhd for the acquisition of a controlling equity stake in Maju Steel Sdn Bhd.
In a brief statement, Sanda said details of the proposed acquisition would be announced to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange once it had been finalised.

Maju Holdings was one of two companies chosen by the Malaysian government to rescue ailing state steelmaker Perwaja Steel Sdn Bhd. The other company, Lion Corp Bhd, however, has backed off from the rescue plan.
Maju Holdings has a 51 percent equity stake in Perwaja while the government now holds the other 49 percent.
